page.layout: One blank page of brownish paper with stains and specks. A narrow strip of printed text, cut off by the scan edge, runs down the far right edge; it is too fragmentary to read and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from stains and show-through. The only printed matter is a cropped fragment of letters along the right edge (a few partial characters per line, mostly unreadable), which is not transcribed. A dark grey area at the top left corner is a scanner or binding shadow.
